description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimesheetDao' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Time\Dao'. It provides data access methods for handling timesheet-related entities like Timesheet, TimesheetItem, and TimesheetActionLog. The class includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying timesheet data, as well as handling reports and filters specific to timesheet functionalities. It cooperates with Doctrine ORM components for database interactions and employs traits for additional services.

classes.name: TimesheetDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for interacting with the database for timesheet-related data. It provides methods to retrieve, save, delete, and query timesheets, timesheet items, and related logs, supporting various filtering and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: getTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheet
methods.description: Persists a Timesheet entity to the database.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByTimesheetIdAndTimesheetItemId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific TimesheetItem based on timesheet ID and item ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsByTimesheetId
methods.description: Retrieves all timesheet items associated with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheetItem
methods.description: Persists a TimesheetItem entity to the database.

methods.name: saveTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Persists a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForStartDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for a given employee starting on a specific date.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Fetches logs related to a specific timesheet, filtered by provided parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for timesheet action logs with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of logs for a specific timesheet with given filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetByStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves timesheets within a specified date range based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Generates a paginator for timesheet records based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getTimesheetCount
methods.description: Counts timesheets matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTimesheetRows
methods.description: Deletes specified rows from a timesheet according to project and activity IDs.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItems
methods.description: Saves or updates multiple timesheet items, ensuring data integrity and consistency.

methods.name: isDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet item with specific project, activity, and timesheet IDs already exists.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of timesheets for specified employees based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for employee timesheet listings based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of employee timesheets matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getDefaultTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches the default timesheet for an employee based on specified filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Retrieves timesheet items grouped and summarized for employee reports.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Counts groupings for employee report data.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration of timesheet items for an employee report based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByProjectIdAndTimesheetIdAndActivityIdAndDate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific timesheet item matching project, activity, timesheet ID, and date.
